source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool Test procedure: 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Error Reporting: True c. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Operation Mode: Programmable Mode d. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Fault Recovery: Always e. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → Release SPD Host Control: Disabled f. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → PMFW Poll DDR5 Telemetry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 0 Enable: I2C Enabled h. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 1 Enable: I2C Enabled i. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 2 Enable: I2C Enabled j. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 3 Enable: I2C Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Fatal error injection: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjpmicerrors --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --railtype 11 --voltagetype 0 --dimm 0 7.Repeat step 1 to step 6 for all DIMMs with different voltagetype as 0/1. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Current Limiter Warning: inject the DDR PMIC Current Limiter Warning via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'PMIC|power.good|critical|over.current|over.voltage|switchover|temperature|current.limit'; echo __DDR_PMIC_Current_Limiter_Warning; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: Current Limiter Warning — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Exercise the DDR5 PMIC current-limiter warning for every approved target and voltage type, verify the approved correctable/fatal handling and OS evidence, then prove the limiter state clears with no unintended clamp, trip, reset or memory degradation.
required_package: Vendor proof for railtype11 and voltagetype0/1 plus warning/status/clamp/trip meanings
Approved correctable/fatal severity, reset policy, assert/deassert thresholds, hysteresis, latch and timing
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller, bus, address, registers and independent OOB path
Joined command form and complete enumerated tuple matrix
Calibrated current/voltage/thermal limits, PMIC/CPER/SEL oracle, recovery and restoration criteria
test_case.test_command: Prove railtype11/voltagetype meanings and the PMIC limiter state machine; map DIMMs, rails, sensors and I2C access; record current/voltage/thermal baselines; inject one tuple; correlate raw warning/limiter bits with calibrated telemetry and fresh RAS records; verify assert/clear timing and recovery before moving to another target.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for Current Limiter Warning. The protected Criteria is `1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Reliability row 99 Wistron-System RAS-00819-V002: prove railtype11 selects Current Limiter Warning and define voltagetype0/1; distinguish pre-limit warning, active clamp and trip; reconcile Fatal label with correctable Criteria and reset/no-reset behavior; map every DIMM/PMIC/rail/current sensor plus Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/register/OOB path; approve command/tuple matrix, thresholds, hysteresis/latch/clear timing, safe limits, PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence, memory recovery, aborts and restoration.
safety_gate: Use a dedicated recoverable SUT with independent OOB and calibrated current, voltage and temperature capture
Keep stimulus within vendor-approved synthetic-injection limits; do not create physical overcurrent to obtain a warning
Run one mapped tuple once and abort on actual clamp/trip, rail droop, temperature excursion, reset, I2C loss or memory error
Capture raw status before any approved clear and confirm limiter state, rails and memory have returned to baseline
Restore all PMIC recovery/mode, SPD-control, telemetry, I2C and HDT settings
expected_evidence: Authoritative railtype11/parameter and warning/clamp/trip state definitions plus full physical topology
Pinned tool/spec, raw register baseline and calibrated current/voltage/thermal baseline
Exact one-shot injection with synchronized status and telemetry timeline
Fresh target-specific PMIC and CPER/SEL evidence showing the approved state and power-action outcome
Deasserted/cleared limiter state, stable rails/thermals, restored DIMM inventory and clean memory health
Configuration restoration diff and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The platform PMIC register map and independent current instrumentation govern acceptance; host logs alone cannot establish limiter state. I2C ownership stays with the Wistron BMC/platform path.

source_conflict.reason: The procedure calls the action Fatal while the item calls it a warning and Criteria calls it correctable. It never distinguishes pre-limit warning from active limiting/trip, and the fixed tuple cannot prove the requested all-DIMM/dual-voltage coverage.
